simple.meaning: Goshen , the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine

definitions.short: Goshen , the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H1657. Goshen גּ֫שֶׁן proper name, of a location (on etymology compare Di Gen 45:10 ) — 1 district in Egypt east of lower Nile, see Eb GS 500 ff. ; Naville Goshen, 1887, who reads hieroglyphics Kesem , but compare Groff JAs xiv. 527 ( ᵐ5 Γεσεμ ( Ἀραβιας )) — גּשֶׁן אֶרֶץ Gen 45:10 (JE) 46:34 ; 47:1 , 4 , 6 , 27 ; 50:8 ; Exod 8:18 ; 9:26 (all J); גּשֶׁן אַ֫רְצָה Gen 46:28 (J), גּ֑שְׁנָה 46:28 ; 46:29 (both J), in both ᵐ5 καθ’ Ἡρώων πόλιν compare Di. (P has land רעמסס 47:11 etc., compare Di 45:10 . 2 הַגּשֶׁן ארץ Josh 11:16 (D), גּשֶׁן אֶרֶץ 10:41 (D), גּשֶׁן 15:51 (P) ( ᵐ5 in all Γοσομ ) a city named with חֹלֹן & גִּלֹה compare Di. — not clearly located, but on southern border of Judah.
